ALTERNATIVE IV
AN 11 MILE LACBD-WILSHIRE-LA BREA OR FAIRFAX-HOLLYWOOD-HOLLYWOOD BOWL RAIL RAPID TRANSIT LINE (FIGURE II.17)
This alternative is a truncated version of Alternative I in that it would stop at the Hollywood Bowl station near the juncture of Highland Avenue and the Hollywood Freeway, and would not provide direct rail service into the San Fernando Valley.
